faqs.q: What is Clippster?
faqs.a: Clippster is a desktop clipping studio for livestream highlights. You watch and clip during a stream, edit on a multi-track timeline, caption the export, and schedule posts to Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube.

faqs.a: No. AI highlight detection is one part of the product. Clippster also includes live clipping with PiP and DVR, a full timeline editor, organization campaigns, and social scheduling. For AI clipping specifically, see the clipping tool page.
